title: Seismotectonic Characteristics and Spatial Seismicity Forecasting
description: Version 2.0.0 of the software supporting Deep-Learning Forecasts of Spatial Seismicity Considering Hypocentral Depth and Stress Regime. Provides data preprocessing and nine-indicator construction, random-forest magnitude-discriminability analyses, fixed-seed ConvLSTM training and prediction, zero/100-placeholder controls, sensitivity analyses, PI/ETAS/smoothed-seismicity baselines, and generation of all five figures and five tables. The matching data release includes the seven formal checkpoints and individual-sample results. The figure/table workflow has been verified after extracting the release archives; new model training and inference were not rerun during archive preparation.
